profile_text.body:
Netflix is a for-profit public company headquartered in Los Gatos, California, traded under the ticker NFLX and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001065280. Its own site describes it as one of the world's leading entertainment services, offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time, according to the company.

The company states it has over 260 million paid memberships in over 190 countries. Its own description does not present AI products or AI services; the offerings it names are entertainment programming and games.

On the legal side, the litigation exposure record for the company shows 264 matters in California. No MCP servers are listed for it.
